info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Channel Activity Update API
info.description: The Channel Activity Update API allows businesses to modify existing channel activity records within their operational framework. This endpoint supports operations for updating relevant details of specific activities, enabling organizations to maintain accurate and up-to-date records. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial service providers that manage customer interactions and channel transactions. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can enhance data integrity and improve operational efficiency.
